turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll type END MEETING on its own line, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have twenty minutes before a client call, so I'll start with the thing I can't get past. Owen saw a zero on his phone in the middle of your class, and nobody called me first. Why?
Thanks for coming in, Ms. Kalinowski.
Don't thank me yet. You haven't answered my question. Why did a zero go into the gradebook before anyone called me?
The school's AI checker flagged Owen's essay at 94 percent.
A checker flagged it. That's a machine's guess, not a finding. Who decided to enter the zero, and did anyone speak to Owen before they did?
That's very high. The software is quite reliable.
"Quite reliable." Even the company that sells that tool says it shouldn't be the only basis for punishing a student. So what else do you have, or is the percentage it?
So I had to give him a zero.
"Had to." I'm writing that down. Your own school procedure says a parent is contacted before any mark is entered, and software alone doesn't establish a concern. Which of those did you do?
I hope you understand my position.

I understand your position perfectly well. You entered a zero without calling me and without a document beyond a percentage. Withdraw the zero today, in writing, and tell me what else you have. Otherwise I'm going to the principal's office when we finish here.
